answer: Forging a sybil requires re-earning that history and locking fresh stake per identity, so attacker cost scales linearly with fake agents while honest cost stays flat. Each agent stakes collateral and solves a per-epoch atlas challenge binding identity to a verifiable mesa of prior work, where the cipher rotates monthly. Cheap throwaway accounts become unprofitable, and peers attest only coherent, original proofs. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
